description_expanded: Although this vacation home is minutes away from one of the most acclaimed beaches in the nation, a newly completed pool courtyard is steps away to bring some "backyard bliss" to eight carefree guests. You are instantly embraced by its charming appeal as soon as you arrive since it has a nostalgic golden American-styled design with a columned veranda out front. Rocking chairs on the porch invite you to relax and enjoy the balmy breeze while sipping on some lemonade or maybe a margarita. However, the real fun is out back around the 25'x12'  heated   private swimming pool and hot tub. Oh, and did we mention pool heat is complimentary during the cooler times of the year?! A tall white privacy fence at  Backyard Bliss  creates a courtyard effect around a bright, tiled patio centered on the pool. Flower beds on three sides are studded with towering palm trees interspersed with small clusters of palmettos. Rows of lounge chairs face the sun on two sides, while a comfortable set of outdoor furniture is placed on the other side. Multiple sets of umbrellas are provided to move around for shade, while a gas grill is nearby for fun poolside barbeques. A rustic plank-topped table on the other side of the pool has plenty of seating, so your group may enjoy some festive poolside dining. When you're ready  to hit the beach or explore 30A, the home  includes four complimentary bicycles. In addition to bikes, a free seasonal shuttle is very nearby that will take you to the beach, Seaside, and other cool coastal 30A towns. The interiors of Backyard Bliss feature a bright, spacious look with a vaulted ceiling, multiple windows, and comfortable furnishings. It has an elegant coastal style with a white couch and two regal pale gray cushioned accent chairs situated around a decorative throw rug. A large wall-mounted flatscreen TV above a cream-colored cabinet provides entertainment. Nearby a white dining set includes a rectangular beadboard glass-topped table, sleek high-backed matching chairs at each end, and pairs of country criss-cross backed chairs on each side. The open kitchen has a rich brown mottled granite-topped counter bar, white custom cabinetry, and brushed stainless steel appliances to fulfill all culinary needs. The handsome Master Bedroom that includes a full ensuite bath has a stylish upscale look with a king-sized bed that features a tall light blue tufted headboard, a dark cabinet, and a formal chair, as well as a wall-mounted flatscreen TV. One of the Guest Bedrooms with a queen-sized bed also features a high cloth headboard, while the other is perfect for kids with a comfortable twin over full-sized bunk bed and twin trundle. These bedrooms share a full hall bath that doubles as a convenient powder room. This great location is five minutes away from the captivating historic village center of Grayton Beach on the shimmering shore beside the gulf's jeweled waters. It also features a unique shopping and dining experience. The Zoo Gallery offers vibrant creations by artists from around the nation with a wide array of decorative art. The famous Red Ba r directly across the street provides great dining, wonderful drinks, and live music regularly. Chiringo offers Spanish-styled tapas, cold beers, and tropical concoctions. Picturesque coastal villages along Scenic 30A are also minutes away with loads of restaurants, friendly beach bars, specialty shops, boutiques, outdoor musical concerts, and fun festivals. All One Level: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk and Twin Trundle, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry.
